# CrazyAIAgent

CrazyAIAgent is an independent portfolio of iPhone and Mac utilities focused on AI photo organization, private photo cleanup, travel translation, Mac screen privacy, and AI creator workflows.

- Anti-spy screen Lite: macOS menu bar privacy utility that uses local face detection to hide selected windows when multiple people are detected near the screen. Mac App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/anti-spy-screen-lite/id6766485393?mt=12&uo=4
